findings.reason: the plan should state that the store-reading §1 needs for the palette candidates lives in one place (a shared function or module) that §2 imports, so the geometry extraction is written and can drift once rather than twice.
findings.text: §1's done-when writes "two to four candidate cross-sections" under `docs/figures/jt60sa-palette/`, which requires reading `pf_active`/`pf_passive`/`wall` from the description store, while §2's `scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py` reads the same store into the same drawable families; because §1, §2 and §3 are separate nodes (followup `f-jtfig-001`), §2 will fork §1's extraction unless the read is factored once

deep_module-1.reason: plan v4 §1 puts the store reader and cross-section function in scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py, which §2 extends and calls rather than reading the store again; plot_style also carries the shared direct-label helper

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — §1 renders the OP1/OP2 cross-section to show the palette candidates and §2 renders the same OP1/OP2 cross-section from the same store; the plan names no single owner for reading the description store into drawable families, so the read is written twice.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the plan routes roots through `imas_ambix/data/paths.py` and cache addressing through `imas_ambix/data/eddb.py` rather than re-deriving either, and it names `read_geometry_table`/the gs facade as the owners a packaged JT-60SA map would eventually use; no un-named shared-infrastructure duplicate.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the only family §1 adds to is public_definitions (the new `imas_ambix/plot_style.py` surface), and §1 names what it retires ("It is the first and retires nothing: `imas_ambix/` holds no plotting style code") with its reason, which the rule accepts.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched `imas_ambix/data/`, `imas_ambix/gs/` and `scripts/` and cites the existing mechanisms (`imas_ambix/data/paths.py`, `imas_ambix/data/eddb.py`, `imas_ambix/data/description_reader.py:113`, `imas_ambix/gs/machine_geometry.py:264`, `scripts/validate_mast_geometry.py:393`), naming for each why it cannot serve JT-60SA yet; every citation was opened and resolves.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — `imas_ambix/plot_style.py` is the repo's first style module (no existing plotting-style owner to extend), it holds the component colour roles as well as applying `data-ink`, and §1 states the inline-styling scripts stay as-is because restyling them is out of scope; the layer is justified rather than a bare forwarder.
